
A decision's context and alternatives are rationale on the constraints of the spec owning its surface; a reversal is an `amends` or `supersedes` edge on the section's rule. The code still ships the `adr` document kind (`lode doc add --kind adr`, `wl:ADR` in `ns/ontology.ttl`), and the nine existing ADRs are being folded into specs and retired. Plans cover rules, never intents. Milestones are the time axis.
